checks.name: CK_NhaCungCapDichVu_SoDienThoai
checks.definition: ([SoDienThoai] like '0%' AND NOT [SoDienThoai] like '%[^0-9]%' AND (len([SoDienThoai])>=(10) AND len([SoDienThoai])<=(11)))

checks.name: CK_NhaCungCapDichVu_TrangThai
checks.definition: (([TrangThaiXacMinh]='TuChoi' OR [TrangThaiXacMinh]='CanBoSung' OR [TrangThaiXacMinh]='ChoXacMinh') AND [TrangThaiQuyenHoatDong] IS NULL OR [TrangThaiXacMinh]='DaXacMinh' AND [TrangThaiQuyenHoatDong] IS NOT NULL AND ([TrangThaiQuyenHoatDong]='TamDinhChi' OR [TrangThaiQuyenHoatDong]='DangHoatDong') OR [TrangThaiXacMinh]='DaThuHoi' AND [TrangThaiQuyenHoatDong] IS NOT NULL AND [TrangThaiQuyenHoatDong]='DaThuHoi')

checks.name: CK_BanCapNhatDichVu_Duyet
checks.definition: ([TrangThaiDuyet]='ChoDuyet' AND [MaAdminDuyet] IS NULL AND [ThoiDiemDuyet] IS NULL OR [TrangThaiDuyet]<>'ChoDuyet' AND [MaAdminDuyet] IS NOT NULL AND [ThoiDiemDuyet] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_BanCapNhatDichVu_LyDo
checks.definition: (NOT ([TrangThaiDuyet]='CanSua' OR [TrangThaiDuyet]='TuChoi') OR [LyDo] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([LyDo]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_BanCapNhatDichVu_TamNgung
checks.definition: ([TamNgungTu] IS NULL AND [TamNgungDen] IS NULL AND [LyDoTamNgung] IS NULL OR [TamNgungTu] IS NOT NULL AND ([TamNgungDen] IS NULL OR [TamNgungDen]>=[TamNgungTu]))

checks.name: CK_YeuCauDatDichVu_DeXuat
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]<>'DeXuatKhac' OR [DieuKienDeXuat] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([DieuKienDeXuat]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_YeuCauDatDichVu_LyDo
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]<>'TuChoi' OR [LyDo] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([LyDo]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_YeuCauDatDichVu_PhanHoi
checks.definition: (NOT ([TrangThai]='TuChoi' OR [TrangThai]='DaXacNhan' OR [TrangThai]='DeXuatKhac') OR [ThoiDiemPhanHoi] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_TinhHuongPhatSinh_KetQua
checks.definition: ([TrangThaiXuLy]<>'DaGiaiQuyet' OR [KetQuaXuLy] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([KetQuaXuLy]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_YeuCauDatDichVu_TrangThai
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='ChoKiemTra' OR [TrangThai]='KhongThucHien' OR [TrangThai]='ThucHienMotPhan' OR [TrangThai]='HoanThanh' OR [TrangThai]='DaHuy' OR [TrangThai]='KhongTiepTuc' OR [TrangThai]='TuChoi' OR [TrangThai]='DaXacNhan' OR [TrangThai]='DeXuatKhac' OR [TrangThai]='ChoPhanHoi')

checks.name: CK_QuyetDinhQuyenHoatDong_LyDoCanCu
checks.definition: ([LyDo] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([LyDo]))>(0) AND ([CanCu] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([CanCu]))>(0)))

checks.name: CK_DeNghiDieuChinhDichVu_DeXuat
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]<>'DeXuatKhac' OR [DieuKienDeXuat] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([DieuKienDeXuat]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_DeNghiDieuChinhDichVu_DieuKienMoi
checks.definition: ([LoaiDeNghi]<>'ThayDoi' OR [NgayBatDauMoi] IS NOT NULL OR [NgayKetThucMoi] IS NOT NULL OR [SoNguoiMoi] IS NOT NULL OR [SoLuongMoi] IS NOT NULL OR [DieuKienMoi] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([DieuKienMoi]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_DeNghiDieuChinhDichVu_Huy
checks.definition: ([LoaiDeNghi]<>'Huy' OR [NgayBatDauMoi] IS NULL AND [NgayKetThucMoi] IS NULL AND [SoNguoiMoi] IS NULL AND [SoLuongMoi] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_DeNghiDieuChinhDichVu_NgayMoi
checks.definition: ([NgayBatDauMoi] IS NULL OR [NgayKetThucMoi] IS NULL OR [NgayKetThucMoi]>=[NgayBatDauMoi])

checks.name: CK_DeNghiKetNoiDongHanh_PhanHoi
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='ChoPhanHoi' AND [ThoiDiemPhanHoi] IS NULL OR [TrangThai]<>'ChoPhanHoi' AND [ThoiDiemPhanHoi] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_DeNghiDieuChinhDichVu_PhanHoi
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='ChoPhanHoi' AND [ThoiDiemPhanHoi] IS NULL OR [TrangThai]<>'ChoPhanHoi' AND [ThoiDiemPhanHoi] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_DeNghiDieuChinhDichVu_TuChoi
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]<>'TuChoi' OR [QuyetDinh] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([QuyetDinh]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_KetQuaCungCapDichVu_DaKiemTra
checks.definition: ([TrangThaiKiemTra]='DaKiemTra' AND [ThoiDiemKiemTra] IS NOT NULL OR [TrangThaiKiemTra]<>'DaKiemTra' AND [ThoiDiemKiemTra] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_QuyetDinhXacMinh_LyDo
checks.definition: ([KetQua]='DaXacMinh' OR [LyDo] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([LyDo]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_KetQuaCungCapDichVu_PhanAnh
checks.definition: ([NoiDungPhanAnh] IS NULL AND [ThoiDiemPhanAnh] IS NULL OR [NoiDungPhanAnh] IS NOT NULL AND [ThoiDiemPhanAnh] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_DichVuDuLich_TamNgung
checks.definition: ([TamNgungTu] IS NULL AND [TamNgungDen] IS NULL AND [LyDoTamNgung] IS NULL OR [TamNgungTu] IS NOT NULL AND ([TamNgungDen] IS NULL OR [TamNgungDen]>=[TamNgungTu]))

checks.name: CK_TaiKhoan_Ngung
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='DaNgung' AND [ThoiDiemNgung] IS NOT NULL OR [TrangThai]='HoatDong' AND [ThoiDiemNgung] IS NULL)

checks.name: CK_TaiKhoan_SoDienThoai
checks.definition: ([SoDienThoai] like '0%' AND NOT [SoDienThoai] like '%[^0-9]%' AND (len([SoDienThoai])>=(10) AND len([SoDienThoai])<=(11)))

checks.name: CK_GiaiTrinhNhaCungCap_XemXet
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='ChoXemXet' AND [MaAdminXemXet] IS NULL AND [ThoiDiemXemXet] IS NULL OR [TrangThai]='DaXemXet' AND [MaAdminXemXet] IS NOT NULL AND [ThoiDiemXemXet] IS NOT NULL AND [KetQuaXemXet] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([KetQuaXemXet]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_LuaChonDaLuu_MotMuc
checks.definition: ([MaDichVu] IS NOT NULL AND [MaDiaDiem] IS NULL OR [MaDichVu] IS NULL AND [MaDiaDiem] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_BaoCaoDH_QuyetDinh
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='ChoXuLy' AND [QuyetDinh] IS NULL AND [MaAdmin] IS NULL OR [TrangThai]='DaXuLy' AND ([QuyetDinh]='DaNhacNho' OR [QuyetDinh]='AnNhom' OR [QuyetDinh]='AnNoiDung' OR [QuyetDinh]='KhongViPham') AND [MaAdmin] IS NOT NULL AND [LyDo] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_ThoaThuanDongHanh_LyDo
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]<>'TuChoi' OR [LyDo] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim([LyDo]))>(0))

checks.name: CK_ThoaThuanDongHanh_Rut
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]<>'MotBenDaRut' OR [MaNguoiKetThuc] IS NOT NULL AND [ThoiDiemKetThuc] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_ThoaThuanDongHanh_XacNhan
checks.definition: ([MaNguoiXacNhan] IS NULL AND [ThoiDiemXacNhan] IS NULL OR [MaNguoiXacNhan] IS NOT NULL AND [ThoiDiemXacNhan] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_BCDH_KetQua
checks.definition: ([TrangThai]='DaChot' AND [LuaChonChot] IS NOT NULL AND ([LuaChonChot]>=(1) AND [LuaChonChot]<=(5)) OR [TrangThai]<>'DaChot' AND [LuaChonChot] IS NULL)

views.name: vw_DeNghiKetNoi_NguoiNhan
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_DeNghiKetNoi_NguoiNhan] AS
SELECT d.MaDeNghi, d.MaNhuCau, d.MaNguoiGui, n.MaTaiKhoan AS MaNguoiNhan, d.TrangThai, d.ThoiDiemGui, d.ThoiDiemPhanHoi FROM dbo.DeNghiKetNoiDongHanh AS d JOIN dbo.NhuCauDongHanh AS n ON n.MaNhuCau = d.MaNhuCau;

views.name: vw_TinhHuong_NguoiGhi
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_TinhHuong_NguoiGhi] AS
SELECT t.MaTinhHuong, t.MaKeHoach, k.MaTaiKhoan AS MaNguoiGhi, t.LoaiTinhHuong, t.TrangThaiXuLy, t.ThoiDiemGhiNhan FROM dbo.TinhHuongPhatSinh AS t JOIN dbo.KeHoachChuyenDi AS k ON k.MaKeHoach = t.MaKeHoach;

views.name: vw_GiaiTrinh_NhaCungCap
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_GiaiTrinh_NhaCungCap] AS
SELECT g.MaGiaiTrinh, g.MaQuyetDinh, q.MaNhaCungCap, g.TrangThai, g.ThoiDiemGui FROM dbo.GiaiTrinhNhaCungCap AS g JOIN dbo.QuyetDinhQuyenHoatDong AS q ON q.MaQuyetDinh = g.MaQuyetDinh;

views.name: vw_YeuCau_NhaCungCap
views.definition:
CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_YeuCau_NhaCungCap] AS
SELECT y.MaYeuCau, y.MaTaiKhoan AS MaKhach, y.MaDichVu, d.MaNhaCungCap, c.MaTaiKhoan AS MaTaiKhoanNCC, y.TrangThai, y.ThoiDiemGui FROM dbo.YeuCauDatDichVu AS y JOIN dbo.DichVuDuLich AS d ON d.MaDichVu = y.MaDichVu JOIN dbo.NhaCungCapDichVu AS c ON c.MaNhaCungCap = d.MaNhaCungCap;
